promotion_rationale: 4 of 10 criteria pass. CRIT-01,03,04,05,06,09 fail because the command file does not yet exist. Creating the command file (TC-W4-002 PROMOTE path) would resolve CRIT-01,03,04,05,09. CRIT-06 is resolved by TC-W8-001 tests. The correct procedure is: create command file first (TC-W4-002), then re-evaluate 10 criteria, then update registry (TC-W4-003). Since TC-W4-002 is conditional on this gate, and this gate currently shows KEEP_DEFERRED, the sprint proceeds with KEEP_DEFERRED path.
